svg.title: 聲音的都普勒效應 / Doppler effect of sound
svg.desc: Wavefront diagram in the air frame, emission and reception time band and comparison table. 空氣參考系波前圖、發射與接收時間帶及比較表。

g.text: 聲音的都普勒效應 / Doppler effect of sound
uS = 0.00c · uO = −0.20c · c = 1, f₀ = 1（λ₀ = cT₀ = 1）· S 起點 x = -3.0 λ₀, O 起點 x = 3.0 λ₀
速度以空氣為參考系、向右為正 / Velocities in the air frame, positive to the right.
A 空氣參考系波前圖 / Wavefronts in the air frame · t = 7.50 T₀
S uS = 0.00c （靜止 / at rest）
O uO = −0.20c
x / λ₀
B 發射與接收時間帶 / Emission and reception time band · 時間軸等比例 / to scale (編號 n = 同一波前 / same front)
發射 Emission (S)
接收 Reception (O)
ΔT = 1.00 T₀
t / T₀
C 比較 / Comparison · 所選波前對 / selected pair #2, #3
量 / Quantity
目前 / Current
參考 / Reference
公式核對 / Formula
ΔT / T₀ 發射間隔 emission interval
λ / λ₀ 波前間距 spacing
(c − s·uS)/c
Δt / T₀ 接收間隔 reception interval
(c − s·uS)/(c − s·uO)
f / f₀ 接收頻率 received frequency
(c − s·uO)/(c − s·uS)
參考：uS = +0.20c, uO = 0.00c, 波前對 #2 / Reference setup
模型 / Model: doppler-wavefront-1 · 結果格式 result: doppler-result-1 · 分享格式 share: v1 · 單位 units: t in T₀, x in λ₀, u in c
靜止、均勻、無色散的空氣；波源與觀察者共線等速，各自低於聲速。
Still, uniform, non-dispersive air; S and O collinear at constant velocity, each below the speed of sound.
速度以空氣為參考系、向右為正；|u| ≤ 0.5c。
Velocities in the air frame, positive to the right; |u| ≤ 0.5c.
波前 n 在 t = nT₀ 自波源當時位置發出，之後圓心固定、半徑 c(t − tₙ)；接收時刻為解析交會。
Front n is emitted at t = nT₀ from the source's position then; its centre stays fixed, radius c(t − tₙ); receptions are exact intersections.
實驗在 S、O 相距 1 λ₀ 前或 16 T₀ 結束。
The run ends before S and O come within 1 λ₀, or at 16 T₀.
分享 v1 只重建起始設定並暫停；結果另存游標時刻。
Share v1 restores a paused starting setup; the result stores the cursor separately.
重現設定與全部事件內嵌於 SVG metadata；亦可另存 JSON。 Setup and every event are embedded in the metadata; JSON is also available.
